title: Sidekick Pulse
descriptionHtml: Sidekick Pulse delivers personalized recommendations and next steps for your business using market trends and data from your store.

rive.description: An array of several tips with vibrant illustrations come together. Abstract illustration suggests that admin data is being pulled together to form one specific suggestion regarding converting customers in the new year.

textRunMap.digestMain/rivePulseTextRun11: From foot traffic to omnichannel growth
textRunMap.digestMain/rivePulseTextRun15: Grow AOV and bring buyers back
textRunMap.digestMain/rivePulseTextRun27: Restock, retain, and raise the value of every order
textRunMap.pulseDesktop/rivePulseTextRun50: New year momentum: convert, bundle, and scale
textRunMap.pulseDesktop/rivePulseTextRun52: A/B test a free shipping threshold to lift average order value
textRunMap.pulseDesktop/rivePulseTextRun53: Your discounted orders already outperform full-price, showing that customers respond to incentives. With a 65.2% margin, you could test a free shipping threshold to raise AOV, without a major hit to shipping costs. Consider A/B testing a $175 threshold for 2–4 weeks and adding cart messaging like "Add $X more for free shipping."
textRunMap.pulseDesktop/rivePulseTextRun55: Set up abandoned cart emails to recover lost sales
textRunMap.pulseDesktop/rivePulseTextRun56: Your store sees 257 shoppers reach checkout each month, but only about half finish their purchase, leaving many carts behind. Automating abandoned cart emails can help you win back these lost orders, with industry stats showing 10–20% of shopper return to complete their purchase when prompted. Setting up a follow-up email series is an effective way to turn missed opportunities into extra revenue each month.
textRunMap.pulseDesktop/rivePulseTextRun58: Launch a new year campaign targeting your clothing bestsellers to boost seasonal revenue
textRunMap.pulseDesktop/rivePulseTextRun59: Hearthside Hoodies did $487k in organic sales in 90 days. Consider launching a 25% off "Hoodie Season" promo with 15% off hoodie + beanie bundles, gift card offers, segmented emails, and refreshed copy focused on gifting and winter layering.
